title: A source whose whole appearance is one external stylesheet
why: Every defect the eighth run found in an authorable replica is on this path and none of them is about the capture: the stylesheet reaches a verbatim page HTML-escaped so the browser cannot parse it (SH555), the generated theme and the section templates were written against different class names (SH556), and the theme a layout pulls in through `getRelation` is reported as unused (SH558). All three are readable in the conversion document, which is why this archetype is worth more than a live run — it makes them fast-tier findings.
